invariant: A second model channel is explicit and enforced, never a fallback: REPOPROOF_DRAFTER_BACKEND=anthropic-gateway selects an Anthropic-protocol transport whose structured output is one forced tool call (tools + tool_choice + input_schema); a reply without that tool_use block raises ANTHROPIC_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_NOT_ENFORCED instead of accepting prose. Only the temperature parameter may be dropped, only when the provider names it, once, and it is recorded. Everything above the transport primitive is literally the same code as the litellm channel, so the two cannot drift in what they ask for or accept. Transport failures project public codes that carry no credential or host.
